description: The week, and no new total

participation.context: Confirmed the days he plays, and refused a sum.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set the week, and kept the book shut on the total.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Named the dark Monday and the days he shares, and would not guess a sum.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Kept the sixteen bars until the parts are out.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Spoke on you, and did not have the tally closed.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You took next week's order and did not ask the takings. The reading is Wednesday morning at Holywell. The old court play was not chosen. Seven shillings stayed a Thursday entry. Kemp kept to you, and the tally stayed open.
